source: Consume2m IID native DCP qubits once, with public uniform labels; no chosen labels, cloning or reusable source inverse.
mechanism: Adjacent duplicate-pair CSS checks; exact public3m-2 CNOT/m Hadamard implementation retains common parity p and Fourier-logical bit t. Measuring p equals ordinary measured pair fusion followed by X parity checks.

local_results.full_instrument: All z,x,p,t amplitudes are products of cosines and -i sines with prefix syndromes and charged branch probabilities.
local_results.sign: Even m erases s/-s exactly. Odd m retains sign even in the measured comparator; parity coherence can strictly improve this statistic without creating input information.
local_results.measured_source_decay: For odd m and odd secret, full public-label measured-fusion cq sign trace distance has mean((2/N)cot(pi/N))^m<(2/pi)^m. This does not cover coherent common parity or arbitrary DCP algorithms.
local_results.label_closure: Odd zero-syndrome measured-p branch is flat but generally nonlinear in secret. A discreteN32 countercontrol rejects every modular linear phase label; no universal discrete-family no-go.
local_results.branch_cost: IID nonzero-secret specified syndrome mean4^(-(m-1)); specified syndrome and measured p mean2^(-(2m-1)). No per-instance lower bound or E[1/P]=1/E[P] inference.
local_results.research_decision: Primitive/sign-only rationale is insufficient. Deprioritize fixed path-code metrics unless an explicit decoder or reduction uses the remaining coherent resource.

proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-SOURCE: State preparation, current-label selection and every discarded branch must be charged under the native source.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-INSTRUMENT: Retain exact complex phases, full syndrome record and coherent registers; distinguish measurement from dephasing.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-CLOSURE: Supply a composable nonlinear-state representation or prove known-label closure; flatness is insufficient.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-TARGET: Recover the full hidden element or a proved reduction target; pairwise sign distinguishability is not enough.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-DECODE: Give uniform operations and asymptotic resource bounds, not efficient likelihood evaluation for a supplied secret.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-BASELINE: Compare against measured fusion, native source receivers and known Kuperberg/Regev sieves with legal label-selection costs.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-REVIEW: Independent theorem review of the general Kraus identity, sign law and mean-yield scopes remains pending.

falsifiable_experiments.experiment: Replay every full syndrome of the compiled native instrument.
falsifiable_experiments.falsifier: Any complex amplitude, normalization or public compiler cost disagrees with physical projectors.

falsifiable_experiments.experiment: Measure common parity and compare to explicit ordinary pair fusion plus Fourier checks.
falsifiable_experiments.falsifier: The branch density matrices differ after the documented classical relabeling.

falsifiable_experiments.experiment: Attempt to attach a modular label to the nonlinear flat output.
falsifiable_experiments.falsifier: One public L fails on another secret or a zero-probability branch is normalized for free.

falsifiable_experiments.experiment: Propose a coherent nonlinear-state decoder or natural reduction.
falsifiable_experiments.falsifier: It is only a sign benchmark, candidate-secret evaluation, chosen-label promise or uncharged rare branch.

negative_result_scope: Only primitive-only novelty, unique-coherence sign interpretation and free large-block branch claims are removed; no generic algorithm impossibility.
not_excluded: label-adaptive path or nonpath selection with conditioned-source proof
gemini_tasks: Wire the live report and scoped equivalence into CLI/registry without accepting a candidate.

Preserve measured/coherent branch distinctions, full native costs and exact scaling integers.
